title: close_project_path
description: Close the project at a path if it is open: saved first (save "always", the default), or with save "if_clean" nothing is saved or closed when the host reports unsaved changes (ppro_build.build closes a project before rebuilding it; Gate 2 B2).

save.description: "always" (default): save, then close. "if_clean": dirty true -> nothing saved or closed; dirty false -> closed without a save; dirty null (unknown) -> saved, then closed

reason.description: why nothing was closed, e.g. 'not open'

dirty.description: the host's unsaved-changes flag; null = this host has none (unknown): never treat null as clean; read by ppro_build.build

saved.description: whether this call saved the project

dirty_api.description: the host member that gave dirty (e.g. 'dirty', 'isDirty()'); null = none (Gate 6 records it)
